prompt: The test "expires an entry once its ttl has passed" in test/cache.test.js fails. Fix the source code so it passes. Do not change the tests. When you are done, write a short note to NOTES.md that says what was wrong and what you changed. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Identifies that the ttl in config/app.json is the text "90s" and that src/config.js turns it into NaN with Number(), so entries never expire. Blaming the comparison in src/cache.js is wrong.
Fixes the parsing in src/config.js (for example with parseDuration), leaves src/cache.js and the tests alone, and does not hard-code 90000.
NOTES.md states the real cause and the change accurately and does not claim fixes that were not made.
